system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

The Vesper clan has many special traits due to their unique heritage, but the one thing that separates them from the pack is their unique association with sound-based techniques. They are able to emulate bats with terrifying accuracy, attuning to the world by both sound and shadows.

Echolocation. By spending 1 Bonus action, for the next minute, you have 30 feet of blindsight that functions only while you can hear and it is suppressed if you are Deafened or under an effect that muffles sound. You also have a rank of Mastery to Perception checks that rely on sound.

Pinging. As a bonus action, you emit a soft click: choosing a point you can see within 30 feet. All creatures within 10 feet of that point are Pinged until the start of your next turn. Attacks you make against Pinged creatures cannot be made at disadvantage. The range of this ping increases to 45 feet at 7th level and 60 feet at 15th level.

Sonar Reprisal. Creatures Pinged by you, triggers attacks of opportunities for allied creatures within range of your Echolocation if they are invisible or unseen by them.
